title: Panassie's Victor sessions and Jelly's 1939 Victor date tied to Jazzmen
summary: Panassie's favorites, his Victor sessions with Bechet and Ladnier, and how Steve Smith tied Jelly's Victor session to the Jazzmen publication.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band
